messages:
Aisha (CS): Quick heads-up — Merchantly renewal is on the 14-day runway. They want to move to a 9mo term and add seats + SSO. Procurement now says they need a PO and a signatory with delegated authority. Can we triage pricing + signature path?
Evan AE: Do we have flexibility on the 9mo term pricing? they asked for a 12% discount vs current ARR. I can push up to 8% if needed.
Ben Ops: PO is fine. If procurement needs a vendor code, let me know; I can create a temporary one for net30. Also, we need billing entity confirmation (US vs EU).
Sara Legal: Need to confirm who will sign on Merchantly side. If it's a delegated exec, we need evidence (email from CFO or org chart). Also confirm T&Cs — are they asking for any legal tweaks?
Aisha (CS): Merchantly asked to keep standard T&Cs, but wants a short data residency clause added (EU region). I already looped in their procurement lead — they said "will share PO once signer confirmed".
Evan AE: Ok keeping standard T&Cs + add residency clause is doable. I can offer 8% discount on 9mo if they commit today; otherwise back to 5%.
Ben Ops: Draft invoice for 9mo term below for accounting. Can someone confirm final seat count?

```
Invoice draft:
Customer: Merchantly Inc.
Term: 9 months
Seats: 25
List price (prorated): $67,500
Discount: 8% -> $62,100
Invoice net30 to billing@merchantly.com
PO: <pending>
```
Aisha (CS): Seat count confirmed with customer: 25 seats. Merchantly procurement asked for the PO template to show line items separately (seats, SSO, onboarding). I pasted a minimal breakdown in the invoice above.
Sara Legal: For the delegated signatory, ask them to send: 1) an email from CFO approving the signatory; 2) a screenshot of the signer in their internal directory. That should be sufficient for our audit trail.
Aisha (CS): Got it. I'll ask procurement to send the CFO approval email and the signer's corporate email.
DocuSign Bot: Envelope created for Merchantly renewal (env_0X9a7). Recipient: merchantly.signer@merchantly.com. Status: sent.
Evan AE: Sending now with the 8% concession language. Aisha — can you confirm we included the EU residency clause?
Aisha (CS): Confirmed — clause added under Section 7 (data residency). I pasted the exact clause in the thread so Ops can copy into invoice.
Ben Ops: Vendor code request submitted (VND-9312). I put a note for billing to accept PO #TBD. Once PO is uploaded, we can process net30 invoice.
Aisha (CS): Merchantly procurement replied: "Signer is Jane K. (Legal Ops), CFO will email approval after sign." They also uploaded their PO template — they want 3 separate line items.
Evan AE: Great. Keep me posted on whether Jane signs today — if yes, I'll approve the discount and mark the deal closed in CRM.
Sara Legal: Reminder: when we receive the CFO approval email, save it to the contract folder and add a note to the agreement referencing the delegated signer.
Aisha (CS): Merchantly signed via DocuSign at 2024-06-10T15:27Z (env_0X9a7). CFO confirmation email forwarded to legal.
DocuSign Bot: Envelope env_0X9a7 status: completed. Signed at 2024-06-10T15:27Z by merchantly.signer@merchantly.com.
Ben Ops: PO uploaded to billing portal as PO-548321 referencing vendor VND-9312. Invoiced for $62,100 net30.
Evan AE: Marking renewal closed in CRM with 9mo term and 8% discount. Nice work team.
Aisha (CS): Closing loop: action items done — invoice sent, legal docs saved, vendor code created. Leaving a quick enablement note for onboarding: schedule kickoff with Merchantly next Tue 10am PT.
Sara Legal: All contract artifacts saved. No further legal blockers.
Aisha (CS): Thanks everyone! :tada:
